stories.title: ICE 'out of control' in dramatic SEA arrest caught on camera, governor says
stories.summary: Dramatic video showed masked ICE officers detaining two passengers on a jet bridge at SEA Airport Saturday morning.

stories.title: Friends describe lives of father and daughter detained by ICE at SEA
stories.summary: Friends describe Sofia Larrondo Hernandez Mejia as a dedicated advocate and community leader who found belonging in western Washington.

stories.title: ICE used 'very poor tactics' in airport arrest, per law enforcement analyst
stories.summary: After reviewing video of ICE officers arresting two people on a jet bridge, former King County Sheriff and law enforcement analyst John Urquhart was critical.

stories.title: 'They're traumatized': Attorney for family detained at SEA denies ICE claims of assault
stories.summary: ICE said it will charge Sofia Larrondo Hernandez Mejia with assault on a federal officer, claiming she threw hot coffee on officers detaining her father.

stories.title: Washington state governor, politicians react to ICE arrests at SEA Airport
stories.summary: Local and state lawmakers are reacting to the detainment of two people on a jet bridge at SEA International Airport.

stories.title: Missing Auburn teen found in North Carolina after two-day search
stories.summary: Family members believe the 16-year-old girl was talking to someone on the game Fortnite before she flew to Raleigh on Wednesday.

stories.title: 1 killed in 2-car collision along Highway 395 near Spokane
stories.summary: Washington State Patrol says the accident occurred around 7:30 p.m. at milepost 179.

stories.title: Big Game of the Week: Enumclaw vs. Mount Tahoma results
stories.summary: Every Friday night, KING 5 will highlight local high school football teams around the region with the Big Game of the Week livestream.

stories.title: Marysville man held in investigation of body found in yard waste container
stories.summary: A man is under investigation for allegedly moving a woman's body into a yard waste container in Marysville.

stories.title: Court order puts former Hoquiam hotel nonprofit purchased in receivership
stories.summary: The Department of Commerce is asking the nonprofit to provide additional information about how it spent two state grants.

stories.title: Lynnwood weighs round-the-clock speed cameras: Safety push or money grab?
stories.summary: Lynnwood may run school-zone speed cameras 24/7 and add two more. The mayor says it’s about safety and money; critics call it a grift.

stories.title: 3 charged in plot to secretly administer abortion medication to pregnant Bellingham woman
stories.summary: Prosecutors allege a man conspired with two other people to secretly administer abortion pills to his pregnant ex-fiancée in Whatcom County.
